title: Legendary Cube Prize Pack: card flavor text

paragraphs.text: "As long as I stand, so will your cause."
Some protection requires a bit of finesse.
"May the memory of our fallen heroes ensnare the violent hearts of lesser men." —Great Threshold of Monserkat inscription
"You have not died until I consent."
The shield of unimpeachable purity is as strong as any wrought on the anvil.
"I prefer loyalty to be a matter of respect, not of magic. But one does what one must." —Kaalia of the Vast
"I search for a vision of Zendikar that does not include the Eldrazi." —Expedition journal entry
"You were saying?"
"I see more than others do because I know where to look." —Saprazzan vizier
"Four parts molten bronze, yes ... one part frozen mercury, yes, yes ... but then what?"
"The specimen seems to be broken."
First the insult, then the injury.
"I appreciate things that exceed expectations." —Mizzix
"Violence is the food it craves. Feed it if you dare." —Doriel, mentor of Mistral Isle
"The cost of your opposition will be extracted from your wits." —Nekusar, the Mindrazer
Friends teach what you want to know. Enemies teach what you *need* to know.
To Jin-Gitaxias, perfection is not a goal, but a process.
"Soaring is wasted on the winged." —Edric, Spymaster of Trest
"The awestruck birds gazed at Wonder. Slowly, timidly, they rose into the air." —Scroll of Beginnings
His slaves crave death more than they desire freedom. He denies them both.
Even when the flesh grows cold, knowledge waits in the bones for a master to release it.
The terrors of the Underworld travel alongside those who return to the mortal realm.
When the winds blow out of the abyss, death is the only harvest.
"Did you have a nice nap?" —Liliana Vess
"May all the cairns of Jund be toppled." —Meren of Clan Nel Toth
Her hunger will not be denied.
"It's a difficult task to quarantine a plague that moves with the clouds." —Esara, healer adept
Linger on death's door and risk being invited in.
In matters of life and death, he trusts his gut.
"For its time as a mortal, Anger chose a shell of boiling rock." —Scroll of Beginnings
Its wings shimmer with dreams absorbed from its enemies.
"Avacyn has abandoned us! We have nothing left except what we can take!"
"For dim-witted, thick-skulled genetic mutants, they have pretty good aim." —Sisay, captain of the *Weatherlight*
"Fate is not as fixed as you might think."
"Behold astronomy's contribution to war." —Fennor Rhyl, starcaller
"Ruhan would never agree to such terms." —Ruhan of the Fomori
Every movement is a summons-even your screams.
"'I have arrived,' bellowed Brawn, and the plane shuddered." —Scroll of Beginnings
All seeds share a common bond, calling to each other across infinity.
She remembers every word spoken, from the hero's oath to the baby's cry.
"Those who do not submit will be consumed."
His roots reach deep and grip hard.
"Words lie. People lie. The land tells the truth."
"Give up these unnatural weapons, these scrolls. Heart and mind and fist are enough." —Zyd, Kamahlite druid
It nurtures its masters' glorious future.
"My skills are wasted here." —Juruk, Kalonian tracker
Slain warriors were buried with a tree sapling, so they would become a part of the forest after death.
"Savagery is the birthright of every creature that draws breath—or wishes it could." —Karador, Ghost Chieftain
Each flower identical, every leaf and petal disturbingly exact.
He speaks directly into his supplicants' minds using fiery words that inflame their thoughts and incite their passions.
Those who worship the great gargantuans could hardly be expected to fight with a subtle weapon.
Swarms thrive in its nest, feeding on leathery bits of discarded wing.
"I am not at liberty to reveal my sources, but I can assure you, the price on your head is high."
"Crovax knows we're coming now," said a grinning Sisay. "I just sent the *Predator* crashing into his stronghold."
"I'll have my revenge if I have to call on every force from above and below."
"Does Teysa think me blind to her scheming? Ambition runs in our family."
"Our revered ancestor Seshiro gave us wisdom greater than poison and fangs."
The clicks and buzz of the undercity proclaim him the incarnation of decay.
The land drank power from the Mirari as though it had thirsted forever.
Vela snuffs out every trace of Krond's reign, leaving pure nightfall in her wake.
After lightning struck the cliffs, the ore became iron, the iron became steel, and the steel became greaves. The lightning never left.
"Ideas drift like petals on the wind. I have only to lift my face to the breeze."
"I'd rather see the guilds contend together with words in the halls of power, than in the streets with swords." —Jace Beleren
Infinite possibilities contained in a finite space.
Urza's metathran children were conceived, birthed, and nurtured by an integrated system of machines.
Even a fragment of a powerstone contains within it not just energy, but space—vast dimensions trapped in fragile crystal.
"We must rely on our own knowledge, not on the dogma of the seekers or the mutterings of the sphinxes." —Tullus of Palandius
"I gazed once into that light. Now it burns in my mind, forever denying me rest." —Riku of Two Reflections
When defeat is near and guidance is scarce, all eyes look in one direction.
"They say the ruins of Sedraxis were once a shining capital in Vithia. Now it is a blight, a place to be avoided by the living." —Olcot, Rider of Joffik
"Let your heels point you home." —Ancient blessing
On Naya, ambition and treachery are scarce, hunted nearly to extinction by the awe owed to terrestrial gods.
Jund is a world as cruel as those who call it home. Their brutal struggles scar the land even as it carves them in its image, a vicious circle spiraling out of control.
For wisdom's sake, it was built high to gaze on all things. For glory's sake, it was built high as a testament of power. For strength's sake, it was built high to repel all attacks.
Those who bring nothing to the temple take nothing away.
